name: ItemGen
teaser: A server-side framework for SPTarkov that lets anyone, including non-programmers, create custom items using simple JSON packs. Includes a web-based tool for generating packs visually and a client-side bundle injector for custom 3D models.
description:
ItemGen - Custom Item Framework

ItemGen is a server-side framework for SPTarkov that lets anyone create custom items - quest items, keys, containers, and stims - using simple JSON packs, no programming required. Custom 3D models and use animations are supported through the included client bundle injector.

What It Does

  • Loads item packs from user/mods/ItemGen/items/
  • Clones existing item templates and overrides names, descriptions, stats, prices, and stack sizes
  • Registers custom items with the item database, handbook, and flea market
  • Supports Quest Items, Keys, Containers, and Stims with category-specific behavior
  • Adds custom items to vanilla traders with configurable prices, loyalty levels, and stock
  • Handles all item registration, validation, and locale injection internally
  • Includes a client-side bundle injector for custom 3D models and use animations via BepInEx/plugins/Serenity-ItemGen/bundles/

Web Tool

Create item packs visually with the ItemGen Tool - pick a base item template, set your custom stats and details, configure traders, drop in custom bundle files, and export a ready-to-use zip.

Installation

  1. Drag the SPT and BepInEx folders from the mod archive into your SPT installation directory.
  2. Start the server. ItemGen loads automatically and waits for item packs.

Making an Item Pack

  1. Open the ItemGen Tool.
  2. Select a base item template, set your custom name, description, and stats.
  3. Configure traders and, if needed, drop custom bundle files into the Bundles tab for custom 3D models.
  4. Click Export to download a zip.
  5. Drag the SPT folder (and BepInEx if bundles are included) into your SPT install to test (ALWAYS use a new temporary profile when testing).

Tip: Always test on a new developer profile (and make sure to clear temp cache) so you can verify trader listings, item rendering, and bundle injection without affecting your main save.

Publishing an Item Pack Addon

The ItemGen Tool export zip is already structured for distribution, users just drag the SPT folder into their install directory.

When publishing:

  1. State the dependency: Your add-on pack requires ItemGen v1.0.0 for SPT 4.0.13.
  2. Do not include the ItemGen DLL or other authors’ packs in your zip.
  3. Test by extracting and running the server before publishing.

Dependencies

  • SPTarkov 4.0.13

More Information

View my framework mods and user created add-ons for them here.

See the full documentation, JSON reference, and examples in the GitHub README.
custom_ai_disclosure: I have been programming for 15 years as a hobby, I use AI to draft and create boilerplates, as well as descriptions. The code is thoroughly reviewed by me before anything is published.

versions.description:
v1.5.0 Changelog

  • BetterKeys compatibility - ItemGen keys now integrate with BetterKeys: map-specific background colors, key descriptions with Tips, Required Extracts, Required Quests, and Behind the Lock loot info.
  • Custom models for keys - keys now support Custom Model and Use Model bundle paths, matching the same pattern used by other item types.
  • Bartering for custom items - custom items can now be added as barter offers in trader inventories.
  • Removed custom stim patch - the stim effects/damage patch has been removed due to instability and conflicts with other items.

v1.4.2 Changelog

  • Fixed an issue where EffectsHealth/EffectsDamage properties were being dropped

v1.4.1 Changelog

  • Added bundle injection/override values for quest items
  • Added stash item size with icon scaling for quest items
  • Updated tool to accommodate these

v1.4.0 Changelog

  • Custom Barter items - a new barters category lets you clone any vanilla barter item, override parent/handbookParentId, stackMaxSize, width/height, itemSound, and properties.
  • Custom Food and Drink items - a new foodDrinks category lets you create one-use snacks or multi-use food/drink items with configurable maxResource/resource, foodUseTime, foodEffectType, health effects (Hydration/Energy), and damage effects.
  • Fixed vanilla stims and meds - the StimEffectsDamagePatch no longer runs on vanilla items, so default stims and other misc items can be used in raid again.
  • Stim-only guard - the StimEffectsDamagePatch and StimEffectsDamageMultiPatch now explicitly exit for non-stim meds, and the multi-patch is gated to custom items only, so other modded healing items will not be affected.
  • Workbench crafting - every custom item type can now have a hideout workbench craft recipe with requirements, workbench level, craft time, and output count. A new Crafting section in the tool lets you configure these recipes.

v1.3.5 Changelog

  • Container loot pool injection - every item type can now be added to vanilla container loot tables. The new Loot section in the tool lets you enable loot injection, pick container IDs, and set rarity.
  • Fixed client icon scaling - fixed a bug where the item icon scaling would affect other items in the stash.

v1.2.5 Changelog

  • Custom secure containers - a new feature integrated into the existing container section: create a custom container and toggle isSecured so it behaves like a secure container in-game.
  • Raw JSON properties editor - new for all existing item types. Add any extra field in the Raw Properties JSON panel; the game will register those fields even though they are not in the UI.
  • Reduced server logging - item generators no longer log per-item success messages. Final startup output now shows registered/enabled counts for each item type plus total trader entries; per-item errors and warnings are still logged.

v1.2.1 Changelog

  • Client-side icon scaling - custom items now render their inventory icon at the size defined by Width/Height, preventing oversized icons from overlapping adjacent slots.

v1.2.0 Changelog

  • Custom keys now work on vanilla doors: Custom keys can be assigned to vanilla doors, including multiple keys per door via door-key mappings.
  • New MedKit category: Create custom medkits by cloning Salewa, IFAK, and AFAK templates with full control over HP resource, healing cost, effects, and custom bundles.
  • Bundle injection supports medkits: Custom medkit loot and use model bundles are loaded automatically.

v1.1.0 Changelog

  • Custom containers in secure containers: Custom containers can now be set to valid placed inside secure containers.
  • Fracture healing stims: Stims can now use EffectsDamage to heal fractures.
  • Multi-limb healing limit: Added maxBodyPartsToHeal so one stim can heal multiple limbs up to a set limit. (Experimental)
  • Decimal stim buff values: Buff value, delay, duration and chance now support decimal numbers.
  • SkillName ignored for non-SkillRate buffs: skillName is only used when the buff type is SkillRate.
  • Web tool updates: Added fields for EffectsDamage, EffectsHealth, maxBodyPartsToHeal, and decimal buff inputs.

First release

Note: Quest items and keys will register fine, but are mainly to be used with the upcoming release of the “Map Editor Lite” mod.

This is a very early version of the mod, many items to be added in the future.
